verifies.G075-C1: renaming the entity attribute title to label through 'Rename attribute and update linked DTOs…' renames the field (and its entity graph node, by the existing source-local rename) and, in the same action and the same Undo, the component of the linked record CrateDto (String title becomes String label). It is an explicit action, not a hook on the IDE's Rename refactoring (the released API has none), offered only where the source-local rename is; mapper code (MapStruct/ModelMapper) is not updated.
